text.tspan: 区分「不可接受」/「不喜欢」/「做不到」
BOUNDARY AND CONFLICT REGISTER 边界与冲突记录表
Separate vetoes, feasibility boundaries, and negotiable preferences.
DOMAIN PROFILE 项目概况
DECISION CHECKS 决策检查
NON-NEGOTIABLE SAFEGUARDS
MUST PASS 硬性底线必须通过
VETO 否决
FEASIBILITY CONSTRAINTS
MUST FIT 可行性限制
BOUNDARY 边界
NEGOTIABLE PREFERENCES
MAY TRADE 可以取舍的偏好
TRADE-OFF 权衡
DOMAIN / SETTING 领域/背景
DECISION ROLES 决策角色
ALTERNATIVES / OPTIONS 替代方案
The domain profile supplies the concrete criteria. Check safeguards first, then feasibility constraints; compare preferences
only among the remaining alternatives.
领域概况提供了具体标准。首先检查保障措施，然后检查可行性限制；仅在剩余备选方案之间比较偏好。
